transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my lower back, mostly. I've been getting a stiff, aching pain across it that's been troubling me for about a month now.
Thanks for telling me that. Could you describe how this back pain has been affecting your day-to-day life, and also let me know if you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
I can't do any gardening at all at the moment, and I need help putting my socks on, which is frustrating. As for allergies, I don't have any that I know of.

Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have taken recently — including any new or changed ones and how much you take if you know — and also about any past health problems, operations, or hospital stays?

I take gliclazide 80 mg twice a day and metformin 1 g twice a day, both for my diabetes. Since the back pain started I've also been taking ibuprofen 400 mg three times a day, which I got from the chemist. As for past problems, I have type 2 diabetes, and I had a similar bout of back pain about five years ago that settled with physiotherapy.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how bad is your back pain on a typical day?
It's usually about a 6 out of 10, though it's worst first thing in the morning.
Can you tell me about anything else you’ve noticed along with the back pain, and what seems to make it better or worse?

The pain is worse when I bend or get out of the car, and it eases off if I lie on my side or use a hot water bottle. I haven't had any numbness around the back passage or groin, no trouble passing urine or controlling my bowels, no weakness in my legs, and no fever or weight loss.
Aside from those, is there anything else you take — like vitamins, supplements, or other tablets or creams you've bought yourself?
No, nothing else like that — just the ibuprofen I mentioned from the chemist.
What worries you most about your back pain, and what are you hoping to get from this visit?
I'd really like to know whether I've slipped a disc, and whether I need a scan for it. That's what's been worrying me most.

Apart from your diabetes and that back problem a few years ago, is there anything else in your health history — like other conditions, operations, or hospital stays — that you think I should know about?
No, I don't think so — nothing else besides the diabetes and that back trouble a few years ago.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed along with your back pain that we haven’t already talked about?
No, I don't think there's anything else I've noticed.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
